WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) as invoice_count 
  FROM Invoices 
  GROUP BY order_id
),
total_sum AS (
  SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_count
  FROM grouped
),
with_sum AS (
  SELECT 
    grouped.invoice_count,
    CAST(grouped.invoice_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(total_sum.total_count AS DECIMAL) as share
  FROM grouped
  CROSS JOIN total_sum
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value
  FROM with_sum
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    with_sum.invoice_count,
    with_sum.share - avg_share.avg_share_value as diff
  FROM with_sum
  CROSS JOIN avg_share
  WHERE with_sum.share > avg_share.avg_share_value
)
SELECT 
  SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoice_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM filtered
CROSS JOIN avg_share
